narrative_purpose: Gives Earth's roughly quarter-tonne flight ceiling a body: Quetzalcoatlus is shown as a giraffe-tall terrestrial animal whose entire lightweight frame is committed to an eleven-metre wing.
subject: A full adult Quetzalcoatlus standing quadrupedally on a dry floodplain, shoulder height comparable to a giraffe silhouette far behind it. The near forelimb is partly unfolded so the viewer can follow the immensely elongated wing finger, thin hollow bones, taut skin membrane and compact torso. A small human palaeontologist silhouette stands well outside reach for scale, holding no equipment with readable markings.
scene: An open Late Cretaceous floodplain at blue hour with sparse low vegetation, a distant herd reduced to haze, and enough empty sky to make the grounded giant feel poised at the boundary between walking and flight.
camera: Low three-quarter naturalist portrait from several body lengths away, entire animal and folded wing visible without dramatic distortion.
light: Cool diffuse sky light defines the long bones and membrane; a narrow amber rim picks out the shoulder and wing root where launch force concentrates.
palette: Deep indigo sky, desaturated teal-grey hide, pale bone highlights and a controlled amber edge on the launch anatomy.
style: Speculative palaeobiology field portrait grounded in current azhdarchid anatomy, painterly and restrained rather than cinematic.
detail_level: High anatomical detail on forelimb, wing finger, membrane attachments and compact body; landscape recedes into haze.
composition: The tall head and neck rise through the right half; the partly opened wing sweeps diagonally into the left half; scale silhouettes remain small and distant. Preserve dark margins around the torso and wing root for labels.
consistency_notes: Depict a four-limbed azhdarchid pterosaur with the forelimbs becoming the wings, not a feathered bird or six-limbed dragon. Its frame must look lightweight despite its great height.
negative_prompt: no text, no museum placard, no feathers, no extra limbs, no fantasy dragon, no aggressive monster pose, no photo, no CGI sheen, no watermark
